status: implemented and browser verified across four viewports

observations: The weekly and expense registers were far below the page start; report tabs appeared after the filters.
The expense form was about 1749 document pixels long and technical report creation about 2766 pixels long.
At 390px, report detail placed the PDF before Modify, with edit/save and attachments several thousand pixels below the title.
Returning from a report detail discarded the report view and register filters.

afterEvidence.status: Passed 24 E2E cases across phone-360, phone-390, tablet-768 and desktop; all 16 after screenshots captured.
